meta.aciklama:
If editing eats your hours, these five free, open-source repos turn Claude Code into a video editor.

1. Ghost Editor (kurbaitaev/ghost-editor, MIT, 214 stars): a Claude Code skill for talking-head reels. It keeps the best take of each line from a raw recording, adds captions that stay off your face and renders on your Mac. It needs a Mac with Apple silicon; a free Gemini key is optional, and the frames it checks go to Google.
2. FFmpeg skill (kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill, MIT, 4K stars): 42 local tools for cutting, removing dead air, captions, reframing to 9:16 and platform exports. Install with npx ffmpeg-skill; it needs FFmpeg on your computer, and no cloud or API keys.
3. Motion Skills (iart-ai/motion-skills, MIT, 1K stars): 56 skills in 19 packs from iart.ai, including a B-roll pack that draws graphics from what you say and a lower-thirds pack. Its video skills render with Remotion or Manim; Remotion is free for individuals and companies with up to 3 employees.
4. HyperFrames (heygen-com/hyperframes, Apache-2.0, 78K stars): HeyGen's free, open-source framework that turns HTML into MP4 video. Ghost Editor is built on it.
5. Awesome Claude Video Skills (zhuyansen/awesome-claude-video-skills, CC0, 1K stars): a list of 419 video repos sorted by type, each with a security grade, plus an end-to-end test of 16 of them.

They run in Claude Code, which needs a paid Claude plan, so try one on a clip you own first.

Follow me, then comment SKILLS and I'll DM you my free install guide: repos I've checked.

Source: github.com/kurbaitaev/ghost-editor, kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill, iart-ai/motion-skills (+ iart-ai/b-roll-skills), heygen-com/hyperframes, zhuyansen/awesome-claude-video-skills, remotion-dev/remotion LICENSE.md, claude.com/pricing (checked November 4). I'm not the expert here. I'm learning this in public. The voice is my own, cloned with AI.

transkript.t: If editing eats your hours, these five free repos turn Claude into your editor.
First, Ghost Editor keeps the best lines from a messy talking head take and adds captions.
Second, the FFM peg skill cuts dead air and reframes for reels with no API key.
Third, Motion Skills, free packs that draw b-roll, charts, and keywords from what you say.
Fourth, Hyper Frames turns a web page Claude writes into a video.
And fifth, Awesome Claude Video Skills, a free list of over 400 repos each with a security grade.
They run in Claude code, which needs a paid plan, so try one on a clip you own first.
Follow me, then comment skills and I'll send you my free guide with repos I've checked.
I'm not the expert, I'm just learning this in public.
